about: Evidence for docs/runbooks/journey-baseline.json read from run 1719: each step taken off, with every test of it in that run's merged report. Written by the PR that rewrote the baseline (#7446).
rule: docs/runbooks/regression-issue-state.md, The journeys baseline: only a pass on main takes a step off (tooling/ci/journey-baseline-guard.mjs rule 3). A step counts as passed only when every test of it passed in that run.

run.shards: 35 of 35 shard jobs success; Plan the shards, Build the stack once and the verdict job (Real-app journeys) success: 38 of 38 jobs
run.report: the run's real-app-journeys artifact, report.json; stats expected 1604, unexpected 517, skipped 3, flaky 0

tests.title: J-agents-03 #5 opens the identity page: owner, scopes and expiry of the agent's own token; a revoke makes the next call fail; a blank token lifetime refuses; a frozen owner makes the token fail too
J-agents-03 #6 asks the assistant to draft an agent: with the model unset the owner-decision notice and the builder still works; nothing saved until accepted
J-agents-03 #6 once the model choice is set a draft appears whose tools passed the validator; nothing is saved until accepted

J-agents-03 #7 publishes to a chosen surface, then edits and republishes: version 1 is immutable; the edit is a draft; republish moves one surface and running sessions keep their version; a surface the policy forbids is blocked with the reason
J-agents-03 #8 shares the agent with a co-owner and deletes a spare draft: a group as co-owner is refused; deletion asks for an irreversible confirmation

J-agents-04 #1 opens the Test panel and runs a test: mode test, billing 0, no reservation or usage row, every reply and log row labelled TEST; on a live-engine deployment the test still uses the mock engine
J-agents-04 #2 tests a tool that would move value: the run reports what it would do and no ledger call is made
J-agents-04 #3 submits a dry run of one tool call: the checks it passed and the would-be effect; no ledger entry, intent or reservation
J-agents-04 #4 looks at the lists: live and test runs listed separately; test runs left out of live analytics by default
J-agents-04 #5 opens Evaluations with no test set: a visible warning that the agent has no test set

J-agents-04 #6 adds cases, repeats and a blank pass threshold, then starts: refused naming the threshold and no run; with it set, cases times repeats results each labelled TEST, and pass or fail equals the comparison
J-agents-04 #7 starts the same evaluation again with the same request id: one evaluation run exists
J-agents-05 #1 writes "ask before sending a comment", then a rule that acts without asking on a live-write tool: the first saves, the second and any loosening are refused
J-agents-05 #2 uses a connector class for the first time: the consent card appears and the call is refused until granted; revoking withdraws it
J-agents-05 #3 runs the agent to the gated tool: the tool has not run, the run reads waiting for approval and a request row exists
J-agents-05 #4 gets the notice and opens the Approvals inbox: the notice names the action and links to the inbox; the push notice shows the vendor text
J-agents-05 #5 edits the payload then approves: a new request for the new payload, the old approval does not carry over; approve runs once, a repeat returns the first result
J-agents-05 #6 rejects another request and lets a third expire: the step ends with a typed refusal; an expired request or a down identity service fails closed

J-agents-05 #7 turns on the automatic reviewer for no-value tools: "proceed" runs a no-value call; a value tool always asks; a refusal is logged with its code; with the model unset the owner-decision notice
J-copy-bots-otc-01 #5 presses Start copying: below the copy verification level, under a blank country list and as a sub-account, each refused by name, and nothing is followed
J-copy-bots-otc-10 #4 rejects with a reason: the applicant sees it and when the owner's wait ends; applying inside the wait is refused
J-copy-bots-otc-10 #4 may resubmit after the owner's wait: the room opens the application again and it waits in the queue

J-dex-protocol-02 #11 swaps from a wallet holding only TEST USD and no native currency, paying the fee in TEST USD at the oracle rate plus the published markup; an off-list token or a stale oracle is refused and the fee is paid in native currency instead

J-dex-protocol-04 #6 creates a claim link for TEST tokens and shares it: a link with the amount and an expiry; the recipient claims once and a second claim fails; the sender can claw back after expiry
J-dex-protocol-04 #7 opens Activity and toggles failed and spam: the counts change with the toggles and the export equals the visible rows

J-dex-protocol-04 #8 speeds up a pending transfer, then cancels another that has mined: a same-nonce replacement with a higher fee; for the mined one the row says it is final and a completed transfer cannot be canceled
J-dex-protocol-07 #3 opens the market brief and the stablecoin screener: a brief or "No brief today"; a blank stablecoin list shows its refusal; the leaderboard equals realised trades
J-dex-protocol-07 #4 opens a token page: price, liquidity in token amounts, fees and growth; market cap "Not available" with no supply source; a USD price with its as-of time
J-dex-protocol-08 #4 opens sub-accounts and a multi-signature account: the sub-account list; the multi-signature control shows its blocker until the contract exists
J-dex-protocol-08 #7 opens the safety education and the audit room: each step opens its control; each product row says "External audit: not done" with no check mark
J-dex-protocol-08 #8 follows the compromise guidance: an ordered list: revoke keys, revoke approvals, move funds, each step linked to its control
J-dex-protocol-09 #8 opens a contract's source status and the Read tab: exact, similar or unverified with the reason; a proxy reads through its implementation; a Write asks the wallet
J-merchant-07 #7 confirms with a fresh step-up and sends: one payout with a receipt; a second inside the confirmation life does not ask again

J-more-catalogue-02 #3 browses vendor listings by category: the taxonomy is svc-market's, and each category shows exactly the listings filed under it, and no listing is ranked or placed above another (RC-more-catalogue-18)
J-more-catalogue-02 #3 every kind of listing shows its review state: svc-market's own, on every card in every category
J-p2p-06 #1 the buyer cancels before paying, with a reason: one refund to the seller, and the cancel counts
J-p2p-06 #5 the release window passes after payment: a dispute opens once, and the escrow does not move
J-pay-03 #5 sets how to treat payments from people not in contacts: a stranger's payment waits, and can be accepted or denied
J-pay-03 #6 adds an email or phone to receive by: a payment sent to that contact lands in the balance; with the sender off the code step shows the notice
J-portfolio-03 #1 opens /money/activity: every kind of movement in one list, in plain words, with signed amounts and local time
J-portfolio-03 #1 a conversion is listed as a convert, not as a desk trade
J-portfolio-11 #4 requests an export for a long range: a job row exists first, the same request returns the same job, and the document centre lists it
J-portfolio-11 #5 a worker dies mid-render: the job re-queues on the same key and the second file has the same content
J-support-public-01 #3 browses a category and then a section: only that section's published answers, and an honest empty section
J-support-public-01 #3 with the whole library empty, /help shows its honest empty state and no sample answer
